historical_references.reference: Babur, the founder of the Mughal Empire in India, was born in 1483 in Uzbekistan as Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur.
historical_references.context: Babur was a descendant of Timur (Tamerlane) and a Turco-Mongol warrior prince who established the Mughal Empire in India in 1526 after defeating the last Sultan of Delhi, Ibrahim Lodhi.

historical_references.reference: Babur's rule marked the beginning of the Mughal dynasty, which ruled over large parts of the Indian subcontinent until the late 18th century.
historical_references.context: Babur's reign saw the consolidation of the Mughal empire and the beginning of its expansion. He is also known for his contributions to architecture, literature, and art.
